Stack.summary: Lays children out in a row or a column with a theme-consistent gap.
a11y: no role: it is layout only

Card.summary: A bordered surface with an optional title, body and footer actions.
a11y: role=group, labelled by the title when there is one

Field.summary: A labelled text input with hint and error text.

onChange.description: receives the string, not the event

error.description: shown in place of the hint and announced

a11y: the label is associated with the input
the error is announced (role=alert) and referenced by aria-describedby

SwitchField.summary: A switch with a label and optional hint.
a11y: the label is the accessible name

EmptyState.summary: Centered message for a list or view with nothing in it yet.
a11y: the title is a heading

SettingsRow.summary: A settings-style row: label and description on the left, one control on the right (the layout of the app's own Settings screens).

focused.description: terminal only: marks the row that has the keyboard focus

a11y: the control passed as children keeps its own accessible name

SelectField.summary: A dropdown built on the app's own Menu: shows the selected option and opens the option list.

options.type: Array<{ id: string, label: string, disabled?: boolean }>

a11y: trigger has aria-haspopup and aria-expanded
Escape and outside click close it (Menu)

Segmented.summary: Tile group for a small set of exclusive choices: DSH's Appearance picker (Light, Dark, System), a full-width row.

options.type: Array<{ id: string, label: string, icon?: ReactNode }>

title.description: visible title above the tiles (DSH shows one). The row is full width: do not put it inside a SettingsRow's right-hand control.

a11y: role=radiogroup with role=radio tiles and aria-checked
roving tabindex; arrow keys move the choice

Tabs.summary: Tab strip with the active panel as children.
a11y: role=tablist, tab and tabpanel wired with aria-controls and aria-labelledby
roving tabindex; left and right arrows move the tab

Dialog.summary: A confirm dialog over the app's Modal, with cancel and confirm actions.

danger.description: terminal only (paints the confirm action with the error role). On the web use the app's RiskConfirmation primitive for destructive confirmations: its Button has no danger variant.

a11y: focus handling and Escape come from the app's Modal

SidebarRow.summary: The sidebar's New Session bar: icon and label when the sidebar is wide, a plain icon control with a tooltip on the rail (extracted from DSH's sidebar).

label.description: visible text when wide, tooltip and accessible name on the rail

a11y: aria-label carries the label in both forms

ToolCallCard.summary: A collapsible tool-call row as in the conversation: leading icon or state dot, title, summary, expandable IN/OUT card (extracted from DSH's ToolRow).

errorSummary.description: replaces the summary on an error row

labels.description: copy; the run-state labels are visually hidden text

a11y: expandable rows are disclosure controls (Enter and Space toggle)
the run state is exposed as visually hidden text, not colour only

StateDot.summary: A small coloured status dot (done, warning, ongoing, error, idle).

DisclosureRow.summary: A collapsible row: leading icon, title, optional collapsed summary, expand on click or chevron.

Menu.summary: A positioned menu of items, separators and labels (built by SelectField).

Switch.summary: A toggle switch with an accessible name only; pair it with a visible label (see SwitchField).

Input.summary: A plain text input (used by Field for its label, hint and error wiring).

HoverCard.summary: Content shown on hover/focus near a trigger.

RiskConfirmation.summary: The app's own destructive-confirmation control (has a danger state Dialog does not; terminal parity note in Dialog).

ConnectionIndicator.summary: A connection-state dot (connecting, connected, error, and so on).

JsonTree.summary: A collapsible tree view of a JSON value.

TerminalBlock.summary: A scrollback view for terminal tool output, capped and expandable.

ReadBlock.summary: A file-read tool card body: numbered lines with a max before truncation.

DiffBlock.summary: A unified diff view, capped and expandable, with add/remove totals.

SearchBlock.summary: A search-tool result list, capped and expandable.

CodeBlock.summary: A syntax-highlighted code block used inside markdown.

JsonBlock.summary: A formatted JSON block used inside markdown.

MarkdownText.summary: Renders assistant/user markdown with the app's own extensions (file mentions, path images, code).

Kbd.summary: One keyboard key or shortcut segment (ported from shadcn/ui's Kbd). Group several with this library's Stack.

ReferenceIcon.summary: The glyph for one inline reference domain (file, web, terminal, and so on).

LinkIcon.summary: The glyph for a file-type or web link, chosen from a path's extension.

Badge.summary: A small status/count pill (ported from shadcn/ui's Badge).

Skeleton.summary: A pulsing placeholder shape for loading content (ported from shadcn/ui's Skeleton).

Spinner.summary: A rotating loading indicator (ported from shadcn/ui's Spinner; no lucide-react dependency).

Alert.summary: A titled message box with an optional icon (ported from shadcn/ui's Alert).
a11y: role=alert

Separator.summary: A thin dividing line, horizontal or vertical (ported from shadcn/ui's Separator; no Radix dependency).

Progress.summary: A determinate progress bar, 0 to 100 (ported from shadcn/ui's Progress; no Radix dependency).
a11y: role=progressbar with aria-valuenow/min/max

Avatar.summary: An image avatar with a fallback shown when there is no image or it fails to load (ported from shadcn/ui's Avatar; no Radix dependency).

ValueField.summary: A settings-style field bound to a text value, with an override badge and reset action.

SecretField.summary: A settings-style field for a credential reference: shows whether it is configured, edits without ever displaying the secret.

SelectPill.summary: A pill-shaped dropdown selector built on the app's own Menu.

AppearanceCubes.summary: A row of icon-and-label tiles for a small exclusive choice (Light/Dark/System), pressed state on the selected one.

Label.summary: A form label (ported from shadcn/ui's Label; no Radix dependency).

Textarea.summary: A multi-line text input (ported from shadcn/ui's Textarea).

Checkbox.summary: A checkbox with its accessible label (ported from shadcn/ui's Checkbox; a native input, no Radix dependency).

AspectRatio.summary: A box held to a fixed width:height ratio (ported from shadcn/ui's AspectRatio; pure CSS, no Radix dependency).

Breadcrumb.summary: A breadcrumb trail: list, item, link, current page, separator and an ellipsis for a collapsed middle (ported from shadcn/ui's Breadcrumb).
a11y: nav aria-label=breadcrumb; the current page is aria-current=page

Toggle.summary: A two-state pressed button (ported from shadcn/ui's Toggle; a native aria-pressed button, no Radix dependency).

ButtonGroup.summary: A row (or column) of controls with merged corners (ported from shadcn/ui's ButtonGroup).

Accordion.summary: One or more collapsible items sharing an open/close model, single or multiple open (ported from shadcn/ui's Accordion; plain state, no Radix dependency).

RadioGroup.summary: A classic radio-dot list for a set of mutually exclusive plain-text options (ported from shadcn/ui's RadioGroup; a native input[type=radio] group, no Radix dependency). Distinct from AppearanceCubes/Segmented (icon-and-label tiles).

Collapsible.summary: The bare collapsible primitive (trigger + content, no chrome) - ported from shadcn/ui's Collapsible. Distinct from DisclosureRow, which is a fully-chromed row (icon, title, chevron).

ToggleGroup.summary: A row of toggle buttons sharing one single- or multiple-selection model (ported from shadcn/ui's ToggleGroup; plain state, no Radix dependency).

Table.summary: A data table: header, body, footer, row, head, cell and caption, each in its own horizontal scroll container (ported from shadcn/ui's Table; no Radix primitive involved).
a11y: native table semantics; the scroll container keeps a wide table from widening the page instead of clipping it

DirectionProvider.summary: A text-direction provider for descendants, with the source's dir prop and direction alias, and a useDirection hook (ported from shadcn/ui's Direction; a plain context instead of Radix).
a11y: consumers set dir on the subtree, which is what decides the browser's own bidi behavior

Marker.summary: A muted label line between message groups: plain, ruled on both sides, or underlined at the bottom (ported from shadcn/ui's Marker).
a11y: the icon part is aria-hidden, so a decorative glyph is never announced

Message.summary: A message row around a Bubble: group, avatar, content, header and footer, with an end alignment for the reader's own turns (ported from shadcn/ui's Message).

Bubble.summary: A chat bubble with seven variants and a reaction pill, meant to sit inside this library's Message (ported from shadcn/ui's Bubble; no Radix, no cva).
a11y: interactive content inside a bubble keeps its own focus ring (border plus a 3px shadow) rather than having its outline removed

Pagination.summary: A pagination landmark: content, item, link, previous, next and an ellipsis, with the current page marked for assistive tech (ported from shadcn/ui's Pagination; the Button item's look is restated locally to stay self-contained).
a11y: nav aria-label=pagination; the current page is aria-current=page; the ellipsis has a screen-reader-only label

NativeSelect.summary: The platform's own <select>, styled to match the library's inputs, for a short static option list (ported from shadcn/ui's Native Select; not the same control as this library's SelectField, which opens a menu).
a11y: native select semantics, keyboard behavior and typeahead are kept; an invalid control is styleable through aria-invalid

ScrollArea.summary: A scroll container that stays in its own box: the platform's styled scrollbars, and reaching an end does not scroll the page behind it (ported from shadcn/ui's Scroll Area; Radix's JavaScript scroller is dropped for the platform's own).
a11y: the viewport is focusable, so a keyboard user can scroll it without a pointer, and its focus ring is visible

InputOTP.summary: A one-time-code input: one real input over a row of slots, so typing, paste and arrow keys are the platform's behaviour (ported from shadcn/ui's Input OTP; the input-otp package is dropped for it).
a11y: the real input carries inputMode=numeric, autoComplete=one-time-code and the caller's label; the active slot shows a blinking caret in place of the one the platform would draw on an invisible field

Item.summary: One row of a list: group, media, content, title, description, actions, header and footer (ported from shadcn/ui's Item; no Radix, no cva, and no cross-item Separator import).
a11y: the group is a list (role=list); the separator is decorative (role=none)

Attachment.summary: A file chip for a composer: media, title, description, actions and a whole-chip trigger, with idle, uploading, processing, error and done states (ported from shadcn/ui's Attachment).
a11y: the trigger and each action are real buttons with accessible names, the trigger covering the whole chip; the uploading and processing states are conveyed by the title shimmer and the state attribute, not by colour alone

InputGroup.summary: One bordered field grouping an input or textarea with addons before, after, above or below it; the wrapper carries the focus ring and the error tint (ported from shadcn/ui's Input Group).
a11y: role=group, with each addon its own group; clicking an addon focuses the control, so a prefix behaves like part of the field; an aria-invalid control tints the whole group rather than only itself

FormField.summary: The layout around one field's parts - set, group, legend, label, title, content, description, separator and error - in vertical, horizontal or container-responsive orientation (ported from shadcn/ui's Field, renamed so it cannot collide with this library's own Field).
a11y: role=group on the field and role=alert on its error; FieldLabel is a real label element; a multi-message error renders as a list rather than one run-on line

Popover.summary: A floating panel anchored to a trigger: the root owns open state, the trigger toggles it, and the content is positioned in viewport coordinates with Escape and outside-click closing (ported from shadcn/ui's Popover; Radix's primitive is replaced by hand, and the panel renders in place rather than through a portal).
a11y: the trigger carries aria-haspopup=dialog and aria-expanded; the panel is role=dialog with the caller's label and takes focus once it is positioned; Escape closes it and returns focus to the trigger; a press outside closes it and leaves focus where the user pressed

Slider.summary: A slider with one thumb per value, draggable and keyboard-operable, with a range fill spanning the lowest to the highest value (ported from shadcn/ui's Slider; Radix's primitive is replaced by hand).
a11y: each thumb is role=slider with aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, aria-valuenow and aria-orientation; arrows move by one step, PageUp/PageDown by ten, Home/End jump to the ends; a disabled slider takes its thumbs out of the tab order and reports aria-disabled

Sheet.summary: A panel that slides in from an edge - top, right, bottom or left - over an overlay, dismissed by Escape, an overlay press or the close button (ported from shadcn/ui's Sheet; Radix's Dialog is replaced by hand).
a11y: role=dialog with aria-modal=true and the caller's label; focus moves onto the panel as it opens and back to the trigger on close; Tab wraps inside the panel. The page behind is NOT made inert, so assistive tech can still reach it - recorded in the manifest rather than claimed as done

footerAction.summary: Register a component in the sidebar footer (root scope, receives { wide }).

headerAction.summary: Register a component next to the conversation title (session scope).

sidebarTab.summary: Register a tab in the right sidebar (session scope).

settingsSection.summary: Add a page to the Settings screen (a nav entry beside General, Models, Plugins). Give `label` for the nav text.

reexports.note: Straight from the app's primitives so a consumer needs one import.

roles.note: Semantic role CSS variables (--acryl-<role>), mapped to the app tokens in contracts/tokens.json.

notes.tui: The terminal library (plugins/acryl-ui-tui) implements every component with pi-tui: the props above, keyboard instead of pointer (arrow keys, space, enter, y/n, escape), and no line ever wider than the terminal.
